source_basis.head: b0050ebe1ff6ca9e89d347aca75d48a31682b33b
source_basis.note: Resolve every executable symbol and byte range from the candidate build maps. Fixed addresses below are stable data/MMU ABI addresses, not stale code PCs.

global_rules.timeout_rule: A timeout means the named boundary or observer result was not established; it is not evidence that target code is slow and is never a pass.
global_rules.natural_input_rule: Only keyboard or joystick events delivered through the emulated/native input path count as natural input. Direct writes to PRES_EVENT, direction, actor, entity, gate, timer, or lifecycle state are controlled fixtures.
global_rules.observer_rule: Use the existing GDB-MCP/native-GDB supervisor and existing capture helpers. Do not extend the deferred web or private-monitor stack.

timing_rule.pass: Maximum complete-frame work for the named executed worklist is at most 29666 cycles, FB_MISSED_COMMIT does not increase, FB_WRITE_FRONT_FAULT remains zero, and only BACK is written.
timing_rule.note: The historical 27000-cycle engineering target and zero-delta no-overlap target are reported as comparisons, not current pass gates. Audio is deferred and no audio reserve is included.

identity_phase.start: fresh launch of the pinned candidate ROM
required: Record SHA-256 for ladybug.rom, ladybug-runtime.rom, ladybug-enemy-runtime.rom, all consumed map/list files, and modified source.
At a map-resolved stable gameplay boundary, verify PAR0=$38, PAR5=$34, PAR6=$3E, PAR7=$3F, and PAR1-PAR4 name the non-scanned BACK owner.
Compare authored module bytes, loader-staged bytes, and live destination bytes over the exact map-derived resident and enemy-module used ranges.
Compare the candidate routine bytes at their map-resolved live addresses before interpreting any breakpoint or state observation.
identity_phase.timeout_means: Artifact, mapping, or observer identity is unproved; stop the issue-specific probe.

phases.name: natural settled recolour
phases.start: natural gameplay is ready at a gate/entity route
phases.method: Using only gameplay input, rotate one gate to the orientation opposite its authored orientation. Wait until GATE_ANIM_ID, RENDER_GATE_ID, and RENDER_GATE2_ID are zero and both owners have published the settled state. Then allow an ordinary BONUS_COLOR transition to drive RF_ENTITIES and an A/B/A publication sequence.
pass: Both physical owners have zero mismatching bytes over the complete gate-plus-neighbor/entity union against an independent oracle built from current MAZE_STATE, GATE_STATE, live nonzero entity records, and current BONUS_COLOR.
The gate remains opposite its authored orientation, the collectible has the new colour, collision agrees with GATE_STATE, FB_MISSED_COMMIT does not increase, and FB_WRITE_FRONT_FAULT remains zero.
Retain pre-rotation, settled-pre-colour, and both post-colour owner regions plus the exact state/worklist values.
phases.timeout_means: The natural route, settled drain, colour boundary, or both-owner publication was not observed.

phases.name: paired composition fixtures
phases.method: Run one bounded fixture set: opposite final-orientation parities with an overlapping heart or letter; a type-zero consumed footprint paired with a non-overlap control; and one pending diagonal-to-final gate beside a settled neighbor. Repeat only the pending case with starting owner reversed from byte-identical pixels, metadata, and intents.
pass: Every declared case executes and reports the actual repaired gate IDs.
Settled unions match the independent oracle byte-for-byte; live entities remain the final entity layer; type-zero records contribute no sprite pixels but retain underlay coverage.
The pending primary then secondary compositor remains final for its owned gate IDs, and the hidden final path records zero calls to the settled repair routine.
The non-overlap control repairs zero gates.
phases.timeout_means: The bounded fixture set is incomplete; missing cases are failures of coverage, not passes.

phases.name: publication timing
phases.start: the same no-overlap, natural-overlap, and maximum-reachable affected worklists used by the pixel checks
phases.method: Capture complete frame_render_impl intervals for the source-matched baseline and candidate, recording scenario phase, executed worklist, repair count, cycle count, starting owner, commit sequence, missed-commit delta, and front-write fault.
phases.pass: Each candidate maximum satisfies the global 29666-cycle hardware/publication rule. Report the no-overlap and affected deltas, including the historical 1034-cycle static empty scan comparison, without treating a nonzero delta as an automatic failure.
phases.timeout_means: No valid timing bound exists for the candidate.

BUG-039.status: runtime contract prepared for the implementation design; not executed

phases.name: natural initial transfer
phases.start: natural live gameplay stage publication after credit/start
phases.method: Capture every committed entry state and both owners. Hold a direction and start key from the first stage image through COMPLETE without writing lifecycle state.
pass: WAIT_STAGE publishes exactly three HUD markers, LIVES=3, and no independent maze player.

WALKOUT changes LIVES once to 2 and publishes exactly one south-facing entrant at $8994+n*$0140 for n=0..11, top rows 168..190; each visible position reaches both owners before the next movement step.
OFFSCREEN reaches logical pointer $9894 at n=12, draws no player bytes, and leaves both owner player-valid fields zero before MAZE_ENTRY.
MAZE_ENTRY starts at $89EC/cell(12,22), moves north by 16 scheduled two-pixel steps, reaches cell(12,18), then and only then enters COMPLETE and permits manual input.
LIVES remains 2 with two markers; held input does not alter PLAYER_MANUAL, PLAYER_WANT, direction, step count, or lifecycle before COMPLETE.
phases.timeout_means: The natural start or complete transfer was not captured.

phases.name: clipping and owner history
phases.start: controlled WALKOUT snapshot with identical A/B pixels and metadata
phases.method: Fill each owner's unused framebuffer tail corresponding to virtual $9800-$9FFF with a retained canary, reverse the starting owner once, and capture player pointer, owner-local valid/pointer/visible-row metadata, old footprint, and final pixels at y=176,178,190,192 and fresh $89EC entry.
pass: Visible-row extents are 16,14,2,0 for y=176,178,190,192.
Capture, restore, stage commit, and sprite commit touch only visible_rows; both owner tail canaries remain byte-identical and no framebuffer access is recorded when visible_rows=0.
Each owner removes its last visible rows before invalidation; no stationary third marker, stale lower-edge sprite, duplicate entrant, or stale $89EC underlay remains.
FB_WRITE_FRONT_FAULT stays zero and both owners converge after the reversed-owner run.
phases.timeout_means: Lower-edge clipping or owner convergence is unproved.

phases.name: natural first death
phases.method: Reach one enemy through ordinary play and capture the complete existing death sequence and replacement entry without writing actor, enemy, death, or lives state.
phases.pass: LIVES changes once from 2 to 1 at dt_finish_blank, one replacement starts through the existing northbound path, the initial-entry state remains INACTIVE, and existing death frame/timer ordering is unchanged.
phases.timeout_means: A natural death and replacement boundary was not observed.

phases.name: reserve stage and award controls
phases.method: Run three declared fixtures: LIVES=1 through one normal death/replacement, LIVES=0 through one normal death/game-over, and a one-dot-left stage completed by ordinary movement at a nondefault reserve count. Run the existing extra-life award boundary once after COMPLETE.
phases.pass: The fixtures produce 1->0 plus one replacement, game over at zero with no replacement, unchanged reserves and INACTIVE entry state across next_stage, and exactly one existing-rule award increment. All declared fixtures must execute.
phases.timeout_means: One or more reserve, stage, or award fixtures did not complete; missing fixtures fail coverage.

phases.name: reset cancellation
phases.method: Invoke the existing reset/new-session boundary once while the entrant is partially visible, then retain both owners through the next live stage publication.
phases.pass: The partial entry and both owner histories are cancelled without stale pixels or count consumption; the next live session publishes LIVES=3 with three markers and a newly armed WAIT_STAGE. No normal enemy, collision, pickup, dot, bonus/perimeter, or stage dispatch occurred before cancellation.
phases.timeout_means: Reset cleanup and the next initial scene were not both observed.

phases.name: publication timing
phases.start: captured y=168, y=178, y=190, hidden, and $89EC entry worklists
phases.method: Measure complete-frame cycles and publication state for each named worklist on both starting-owner orders.
phases.pass: Every maximum satisfies the global 29666-cycle hardware/publication rule and movement advances only on the existing 30 Hz scheduled cadence.
phases.timeout_means: No valid timing/publication bound exists for the entry implementation.

phases.name: controlled stale writer
phases.method: Install one legal record [12,10,ENTITY_HEART,OBJECT_HEART], BONUS_COLOR=COLOR_YELLOW, and otherwise source-valid stage state. Let normal stage rendering perform ERF_INIT capture. Use the normal pickup path to clear that record, let RF_ENTITIES publish the clean footprint, then request one existing logical ERF_NEST intent and let its normal A/B damage replay complete through enemy_render_impl. Capture the entity record, ENEMY_ZONE_BG, ENEMY_ZONE_STAGE, render intents, and both physical nest regions at all three boundaries.
pass: After stage capture, ENEMY_ZONE_BG contains the yellow heart pixels and the live entity type is 2.
After normal pickup, type is 0, the published footprint matches the independent current-state clean nest image, and ENEMY_ZONE_BG retains its prior hash.

After structural compose, exactly the witness set is reintroduced: 35 differing upper-zone bytes and 45 yellow pixels, all attributable to compose_enemy_zone copying ENEMY_ZONE_BG while the record remains type 0.
Both owners reproduce the same causal transition; pickup dispatch skips the type-zero record.
phases.timeout_means: The source-identical capture, pickup, or structural writer boundary was not observed; the mechanism remains runtime-unconfirmed.

phases.name: natural attribution
phases.start: natural later-stage gameplay with BONUS_COLOR yellow
phases.method: Without changing entity placement, colour, timers, collision, actor position, or render intents, observe normal pickups and structural nest redraws. On first matching yellow object, capture the same record/cache/stage/both-owner state and attempt collection through ordinary movement.
phases.pass: The naturally observed pixels, location, type-zero non-collection, retained ENEMY_ZONE_BG bytes, and compose_enemy_zone writer match the controlled causal signature.
phases.timeout_means: Exact attribution of the user's reported occurrence remains unconfirmed; the controlled mechanism is retained separately.
